_comment: The AleutianChain conformance vectors, and their digests. THIS FILE IS THE CONTRACT. Every implementation claiming compatibility must reproduce these vectors' expected outputs exactly. The digests exist so that a copy vendored into another repository cannot drift unnoticed: an implementation reads its local copy and checks it against these digests before trusting it. Changing a vector is a deliberate act that changes a digest here, which every other implementation then notices. A vector must never be regenerated to make a failing implementation pass -- that is the circularity these vectors exist to break.
